name: crewforge
description: CrewForge — agent crews as a managed resource, behind three commands: /crewforge:init, /crewforge:plan and /crewforge:execute.

plugins.name: crewforge
plugins.description: Three commands over one repo: /crewforge:init audits and slims your Claude config, /crewforge:plan turns a goal into an adversarially-reviewed plan, and /crewforge:execute drives that plan to a merged commit with a generated agent crew and its quality gates.
